title: NEWLY SINGLE
lines: Newly single is a library of stacks.
It keeps 950 shots from 129 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 5 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Rooftop club, strobe, shifted time”.
The tallest tower is Adelante Cubanos (Part I) (1959): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1912 or newer than 2016.
The sign most often read here is figure of enfeeblement.
